"""Migrated Meridian CRM case_lifecycle workflow."""

from typing import Any, Callable

Guard = Callable[[dict[str, Any]], bool]
Action = tuple[str, str, str | None]
Transition = tuple[str, str, str, Guard | None, tuple[Action, ...]]


def _owner_present(record: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    return record.get("OWNER_UID", "") != ""


def _not_escalated(record: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    return record.get("ESC_FLG", "") != "Y"


def _has_resolution_date(record: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    return record.get("RES_DT", "") != "00000000"


_TRANSITIONS: tuple[Transition, ...] = (
    (
        "N",
        "A",
        "assign",
        _owner_present,
        (("audit", "CASE_ASSIGN", None),),
    ),
    (
        "N",
        "A",
        "auto_escalate",
        None,
        (
            ("set", "ESC_FLG", "Y"),
            ("set", "SEV_CD", "=NVL(SEV_CD,'3')"),
            ("audit", "CASE_ESC", None),
            ("notify", "escalation", None),
        ),
    ),
    (
        "A",
        "A",
        "auto_escalate",
        _not_escalated,
        (
            ("set", "ESC_FLG", "Y"),
            ("audit", "CASE_ESC", None),
            ("notify", "escalation", None),
        ),
    ),
    (
        "A",
        "P",
        "await_customer",
        None,
        (("audit", "CASE_PEND", None),),
    ),
    (
        "P",
        "A",
        "customer_reply",
        None,
        (),
    ),
    (
        "A",
        "R",
        "resolve",
        _has_resolution_date,
        (("audit", "CASE_RES", None),),
    ),
    (
        "R",
        "X",
        "close",
        None,
        (("audit", "CASE_CLOSE", None),),
    ),
    (
        "R",
        "A",
        "reopen",
        None,
        (
            ("set", "RES_DT", "00000000"),
            ("audit", "CASE_REOPEN", None),
        ),
    ),
)


def _evaluate_set_value(value: str, record: dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
    if value == "=NVL(SEV_CD,'3')":
        current = record.get("SEV_CD", "")
        return current if current != "" else "3"
    return value


def fire(state: str, event: str, record: dict) -> dict:
    """Dispatch one explicit event through the case lifecycle workflow."""
    updated_record = dict(record)

    for source, target, transition_event, guard, actions in _TRANSITIONS:
        if source != state or transition_event != event:
            continue
        if guard is not None and not guard(updated_record):
            continue

        audits: list[str] = []
        notifies: list[str] = []

        for action_type, name, value in actions:
            if action_type == "set":
                updated_record[name] = _evaluate_set_value(value, updated_record)
            elif action_type == "audit":
                audits.append(name)
            elif action_type == "notify":
                notifies.append(name)

        return {
            "state": target,
            "record": updated_record,
            "audits": audits,
            "notifies": notifies,
            "matched": True,
        }

    return {
        "state": state,
        "record": updated_record,
        "audits": ["WF_NOMATCH"],
        "notifies": [],
        "matched": False,
    }
